chunks: The like of whom were never created in the realm;
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that something was 'not created like it' in the lands?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is frequently interpreted as referring to the unique spiritual station of the Ahl al-Bayt or the Imams, who possess a distinct ontological reality not replicated by previous creations. It underscores their role as the ultimate manifestation of divine knowledge and authority, establishing a new paradigm in human history that transcends mere physical existence.
